text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: You don't seem nervous at all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? O-Of course I am...? The Tenno Sho 
(Spring) is an incredibly historic race, 
after all...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The tip of my tail is tingling with 
nerves... I've reviewed the info on my 
opponents over and over again.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I can achieve results here... as 
a hero, I'll be able to make a bit of a 
name for myself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
When I think about that... it's not 
nervousness, but excitement... that makes 
my heart pound a little.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Ah, look at the time. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A small back that doesn't look back. Yet, 
barely a trace remains of that girl who 
was trembling during her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believing she would achieve fantastic 
results, I gently gave her a push on the 
back.
